+name: 🔬 Native Doc flush diagnosis
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [opened]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: native-doc-diagnostic-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  observation:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush'
+    name: One prior-native mobile observation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      VITE_SYNC_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_SELECTION_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_RESPONSIVENESS_EVIDENCE: '1'
+      VITE_DOC_FLUSH_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN146_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN108_BASELINE: '0'
+      SPINEL_E2E_PROJECT: doc-responsiveness
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean candidate dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+      - name: Install Chromium
+        run: |
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - name: Bind exact prior native implementation
+        run: node scripts/ci/prepare-doc-native-diagnostic.ts --prior-native
+      - name: Build diagnostic application
+        run: npm run build
+      - name: One diagnostic first attempt
+        run: npx playwright test --project=doc-responsiveness --grep 'mobile sustained native typing profile$' --retries=0
+      - name: Preserve complete or partial observation
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
+        with:
+          name: spn146-prior-native-diagnostic
+          path: |
+            spn146-diagnostic-build.json
+            test-results/doc-responsiveness/
+            playwright-report/doc-responsiveness.json
+            !test-results/**/*.sqlite*
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

+name: 🔬 Native Doc component counterfactual
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [synchronize]
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: spn146-native-component
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  component:
+    # One reachable pre-merge update only. Edits and later repair pushes cannot
+    # renew the registered allowance; GitHub reruns fail before installation.
+    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush' && github.event.before == '7e041c0c7c84bc28c56aeff1bda35b2a93654114'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    env:
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT: test-results/spn146-native-runtime
+    steps:
+      - name: Admit only the first workflow attempt
+        run: test "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean dependencies and pinned browser/converter
+        timeout-minutes: 8
+        run: |
+          export DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/spn146-trace-processor"
+          printf '%s\n' "DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH=$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          npm ci
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+          node scripts/ci/doc-trace-processor.ts "$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH"
+          mkdir -p "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT"
+      - name: Prepare the fixed component bundle
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/preparation-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/build.ts
+      - name: One fixed 32-observation experiment
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/observation-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/run.ts
+      - name: Convert complete trace and assess every comparison
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/analysis-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/convert.ts
+      - name: Preserve complete or partial evidence
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
+        with:
+          name: spn146-linux-native-component
+          path: test-results/spn146-native-runtime/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

+name: 🔬 Native Doc flush diagnosis
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [opened]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: native-doc-diagnostic-${{ github.ref }}

+
+jobs:
+  observation:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush'
+    name: One prior-native mobile observation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      VITE_SYNC_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_SELECTION_EVIDENCE: '0'

+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7

+name: 🔬 Native Doc flush diagnosis
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [opened]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: native-doc-diagnostic-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  observation:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush'
+    name: One prior-native mobile observation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      VITE_SYNC_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_SELECTION_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_RESPONSIVENESS_EVIDENCE: '1'
+      VITE_DOC_FLUSH_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN146_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN108_BASELINE: '0'
+      SPINEL_E2E_PROJECT: doc-responsiveness
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean candidate dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+      - name: Install Chromium
+        run: |
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - name: Bind exact prior native implementation
+        run: node scripts/ci/prepare-doc-native-diagnostic.ts --prior-native
+      - name: Build diagnostic application
+        run: npm run build
+      - name: One diagnostic first attempt

+            !test-results/**/*.sqlite*

+name: 🔬 Native Doc flush diagnosis
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [opened]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: native-doc-diagnostic-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  observation:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush'
+    name: One prior-native mobile observation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      VITE_SYNC_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_SELECTION_EVIDENCE: '0'

+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7

+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7

+name: 🔬 Native Doc flush diagnosis
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [opened]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: native-doc-diagnostic-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  observation:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush'
+    name: One prior-native mobile observation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      VITE_SYNC_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_SELECTION_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_RESPONSIVENESS_EVIDENCE: '1'

+      SPN108_BASELINE: '0'

+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7

+  group: spn146-native-component

+

+name: 🔬 Native Doc flush diagnosis
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [opened]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: native-doc-diagnostic-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  observation:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush'
+    name: One prior-native mobile observation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      VITE_SYNC_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_SELECTION_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_RESPONSIVENESS_EVIDENCE: '1'
+      VITE_DOC_FLUSH_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN146_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN108_BASELINE: '0'
+      SPINEL_E2E_PROJECT: doc-responsiveness
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean candidate dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+      - name: Install Chromium
+        run: |
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - name: Bind exact prior native implementation
+        run: node scripts/ci/prepare-doc-native-diagnostic.ts --prior-native
+      - name: Build diagnostic application
+        run: npm run build
+      - name: One diagnostic first attempt

+      - name: Preserve complete or partial observation

+            !test-results/**/*.sqlite*

+          retention-days: 30

+name: 🔬 Native Doc component counterfactual
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [synchronize]
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: spn146-native-component
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  component:
+    # One reachable pre-merge update only. Edits and later repair pushes cannot
+    # renew the registered allowance; GitHub reruns fail before installation.
+    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush' && github.event.before == '7e041c0c7c84bc28c56aeff1bda35b2a93654114'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    env:
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT: test-results/spn146-native-runtime
+    steps:
+      - name: Admit only the first workflow attempt
+        run: test "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean dependencies and pinned browser/converter
+        timeout-minutes: 8
+        run: |
+          export DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/spn146-trace-processor"
+          printf '%s\n' "DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH=$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          npm ci
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+          node scripts/ci/doc-trace-processor.ts "$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH"
+          mkdir -p "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT"

+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/preparation-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/build.ts
+      - name: One fixed 32-observation experiment
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/observation-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/run.ts

 # ⚡ SPN-146 — mobile native flush budget
 
+## 🚀 Production run resume and first diagnostic
+
+**2026-11-04 America/Los_Angeles — owner requests continuing the backlog toward
+production.** Work starts on new branch `codex/spn-146-mobile-flush` from accepted
+main `2f442317dd2e1c188ae4a810ac094fd1162a4a2a`. No SPN-146 implementation branch
+or PR was found in the live remote inventory. The prior investigating chat is
+idle and records an execution-capability blocker, not a completed repair. No
+foreign branch is taken over. The owner's new rule requires a branch this agent
+did not create to be at least two hours old before takeover; verify that age and
+current ownership before any later takeover, preserving active/uncommitted work.
+
+SPN-141 now supplies two additional first-attempt failures on source
+`4e593fbaf9ea89585920053b9415f9a8eac0944f`, CI41970163093, job127056548327:
+plain1 capacity pair62/state1984 measures116.5ms (history56.9, collaboration59.6);
+plain3 pair17/state544 measures122.3ms (native121.5 plus0.8 outer remainder).
+Both clear32/32 queues to0/0; their overlapping long tasks are197/177ms. Neither
+failed interval has a CPU profile/trace. Full66-group history and content evidence
+remain separate from the failed maximum. The exact raw23-member artifact and
+independent reviews are preserved in immutable checkpoint
+[`b55833f5`](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/b55833f51111f772497d0c24ed81859dba4e8b22/docs/review-assets/spn-141-mobile-blocker-4e593fba).
+Its posted receipt and terminal redundant metadata cancellation are preserved in
+[`41962c6f`](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/41962c6f664995e59676d310db95110f9b9715c1/docs/review-assets/spn-141-blocked-receipt-4e593fba).
+SPN-141/140/120 and SPN-089 remain blocked; no old green or unchanged rerun is
+acceptance for these failures.
+
+### 🔬 Finite offline capability checkpoint
+
+Complete scope remains **XL**: causal/native-runtime diagnosis, a supported
+algorithm or measurement repair, exact semantics/history/access/persistence,
+meaningful negative controls, hosted unprofiled acceptance and integration.
+First distinguish deterministic composition work from unobserved runtime pauses.
+All four failed windows contain a paragraph boundary in fixed-workload arithmetic:
+states672/1440/1984/544 place Enter at zero-based offsets9/23/3/7. This is source
+arithmetic, not a captured action-cache identity or proof of cause.
+
+**Hypothesis:** the currently qualified leading-prefix optimization leaves
+substantial native work in a structural paragraph-containing cache, whereas plain
+typing caches are substantially cheaper. Reuse the existing actual manager
+fixture and eight lossless synthetic native captures, SHA256
+`714376723b3ef6a048796f7a1903a58181098960960cecb111e22e0594a2e7c8`.

+hashes and zero owned fixture timers/listeners after disposal. Wall times include
+instrumentation and controlled fixture endpoints; they are not browser latency
+or a reconstruction of any failed sample.
+

+pressure. Stop on the first hash/semantic/order/cleanup/resource failure and retain
+partial results. A setup repair must preserve its original failure. If no useful
+work distinction appears, stop this hypothesis as inconclusive; do not renew the
+same probe. If a distinction appears, record it and preregister any next semantic
+experiment or actual-runtime diagnostic before execution. No production change
+is admitted by a faster local timing alone.
+
+Operator gains an attributable finite investigation. Owner and Collaborator keep
+exact editing/history/persistence and unchanged responsiveness limits; editable
+Link guests retain every access fence. Production readiness does not justify
+dropping first failures, weakening100ms maxima or extrapolating CPU profiles from
+different samples. Existing dependency routing and all selected acceptance owners

+
+### 📊 First offline result
+
+All32 declared flushes passed complete raw publication parity, input/property
+nonmutation and fixture cleanup on the first execution:1007ms including watchdog,
+416928KiB sampled peak, normal pressure. [Lossless probe/results/log manifest](evidence/SPN-146/offline-work/manifest.json)

+These are native primitive counters, not all V8 allocations. Instrumented Node

+This supports investigating the remaining structural composition work. It does

+

+name: 🔬 Native Doc flush diagnosis
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [opened]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: native-doc-diagnostic-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  observation:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush'
+    name: One prior-native mobile observation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      VITE_SYNC_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_SELECTION_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_RESPONSIVENESS_EVIDENCE: '1'
+      VITE_DOC_FLUSH_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN146_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN108_BASELINE: '0'
+      SPINEL_E2E_PROJECT: doc-responsiveness
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc

+      - name: Clean candidate dependencies

+      - name: Install Chromium

+name: 🔬 Native Doc component counterfactual
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [synchronize]
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: spn146-native-component
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  component:
+    # One reachable pre-merge update only. Edits and later repair pushes cannot
+    # renew the registered allowance; GitHub reruns fail before installation.
+    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush' && github.event.before == '7e041c0c7c84bc28c56aeff1bda35b2a93654114'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    env:
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT: test-results/spn146-native-runtime
+    steps:
+      - name: Admit only the first workflow attempt
+        run: test "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean dependencies and pinned browser/converter
+        timeout-minutes: 8
+        run: |
+          export DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/spn146-trace-processor"
+          printf '%s\n' "DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH=$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          npm ci
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+          node scripts/ci/doc-trace-processor.ts "$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH"

+
+### 🔬 Finite offline capability checkpoint
+
+Complete scope remains **XL**: causal/native-runtime diagnosis, a supported
+algorithm or measurement repair, exact semantics/history/access/persistence,
+meaningful negative controls, hosted unprofiled acceptance and integration.
+First distinguish deterministic composition work from unobserved runtime pauses.

+work distinction appears, stop this hypothesis as inconclusive; do not renew the

+

+exact editing/history/persistence and unchanged responsiveness limits; editable

+dropping first failures, weakening100ms maxima or extrapolating CPU profiles from

+

+name: 🔬 Native Doc flush diagnosis
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [opened]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: native-doc-diagnostic-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  observation:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush'
+    name: One prior-native mobile observation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      VITE_SYNC_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_SELECTION_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_RESPONSIVENESS_EVIDENCE: '1'
+      VITE_DOC_FLUSH_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN146_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN108_BASELINE: '0'
+      SPINEL_E2E_PROJECT: doc-responsiveness
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean candidate dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+      - name: Install Chromium
+        run: |
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - name: Bind exact prior native implementation

+      - name: Build diagnostic application
+        run: npm run build
+      - name: One diagnostic first attempt

+      - name: Preserve complete or partial observation

+            !test-results/**/*.sqlite*
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

+name: 🔬 Native Doc component counterfactual
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [synchronize]
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: spn146-native-component
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  component:
+    # One reachable pre-merge update only. Edits and later repair pushes cannot
+    # renew the registered allowance; GitHub reruns fail before installation.
+    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush' && github.event.before == '7e041c0c7c84bc28c56aeff1bda35b2a93654114'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    env:
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT: test-results/spn146-native-runtime
+    steps:
+      - name: Admit only the first workflow attempt
+        run: test "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean dependencies and pinned browser/converter
+        timeout-minutes: 8
+        run: |
+          export DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/spn146-trace-processor"
+          printf '%s\n' "DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH=$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          npm ci
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+          node scripts/ci/doc-trace-processor.ts "$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH"
+          mkdir -p "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT"
+      - name: Prepare the fixed component bundle
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/preparation-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/build.ts
+      - name: One fixed 32-observation experiment
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/observation-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/run.ts

+### 🔬 Finite offline capability checkpoint
+
+Complete scope remains **XL**: causal/native-runtime diagnosis, a supported
+algorithm or measurement repair, exact semantics/history/access/persistence,
+meaningful negative controls, hosted unprofiled acceptance and integration.
+First distinguish deterministic composition work from unobserved runtime pauses.

+name: 🔬 Native Doc flush diagnosis
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [opened]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: native-doc-diagnostic-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  observation:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush'
+    name: One prior-native mobile observation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      VITE_SYNC_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_SELECTION_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_RESPONSIVENESS_EVIDENCE: '1'
+      VITE_DOC_FLUSH_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN146_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN108_BASELINE: '0'
+      SPINEL_E2E_PROJECT: doc-responsiveness
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean candidate dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+      - name: Install Chromium
+        run: |
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - name: Bind exact prior native implementation
+        run: node scripts/ci/prepare-doc-native-diagnostic.ts --prior-native
+      - name: Build diagnostic application
+        run: npm run build
+      - name: One diagnostic first attempt
+        run: npx playwright test --project=doc-responsiveness --grep 'mobile sustained native typing profile$' --retries=0
+      - name: Preserve complete or partial observation
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2

+          path: |
+            spn146-diagnostic-build.json
+            test-results/doc-responsiveness/
+            playwright-report/doc-responsiveness.json
+            !test-results/**/*.sqlite*
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

+name: 🔬 Native Doc component counterfactual
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [synchronize]
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: spn146-native-component
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  component:
+    # One reachable pre-merge update only. Edits and later repair pushes cannot
+    # renew the registered allowance; GitHub reruns fail before installation.
+    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush' && github.event.before == '7e041c0c7c84bc28c56aeff1bda35b2a93654114'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    env:
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT: test-results/spn146-native-runtime
+    steps:
+      - name: Admit only the first workflow attempt
+        run: test "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean dependencies and pinned browser/converter
+        timeout-minutes: 8
+        run: |
+          export DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/spn146-trace-processor"
+          printf '%s\n' "DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH=$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          npm ci
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+          node scripts/ci/doc-trace-processor.ts "$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH"
+          mkdir -p "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT"
+      - name: Prepare the fixed component bundle
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/preparation-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/build.ts
+      - name: One fixed 32-observation experiment
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/observation-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/run.ts
+      - name: Convert complete trace and assess every comparison
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/analysis-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/convert.ts

+        if: always()

+          path: test-results/spn146-native-runtime/

+          retention-days: 30

 # ⚡ SPN-146 — mobile native flush budget
 
+## 🚀 Production run resume and first diagnostic
+
+**2026-11-04 America/Los_Angeles — owner requests continuing the backlog toward
+production.** Work starts on new branch `codex/spn-146-mobile-flush` from accepted
+main `2f442317dd2e1c188ae4a810ac094fd1162a4a2a`. No SPN-146 implementation branch
+or PR was found in the live remote inventory. The prior investigating chat is
+idle and records an execution-capability blocker, not a completed repair. No
+foreign branch is taken over. The owner's new rule requires a branch this agent
+did not create to be at least two hours old before takeover; verify that age and
+current ownership before any later takeover, preserving active/uncommitted work.
+
+SPN-141 now supplies two additional first-attempt failures on source
+`4e593fbaf9ea89585920053b9415f9a8eac0944f`, CI41970163093, job127056548327:
+plain1 capacity pair62/state1984 measures116.5ms (history56.9, collaboration59.6);
+plain3 pair17/state544 measures122.3ms (native121.5 plus0.8 outer remainder).
+Both clear32/32 queues to0/0; their overlapping long tasks are197/177ms. Neither
+failed interval has a CPU profile/trace. Full66-group history and content evidence
+remain separate from the failed maximum. The exact raw23-member artifact and
+independent reviews are preserved in immutable checkpoint
+[`b55833f5`](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/b55833f51111f772497d0c24ed81859dba4e8b22/docs/review-assets/spn-141-mobile-blocker-4e593fba).
+Its posted receipt and terminal redundant metadata cancellation are preserved in
+[`41962c6f`](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/41962c6f664995e59676d310db95110f9b9715c1/docs/review-assets/spn-141-blocked-receipt-4e593fba).
+SPN-141/140/120 and SPN-089 remain blocked; no old green or unchanged rerun is
+acceptance for these failures.
+
+### 🔬 Finite offline capability checkpoint
+
+Complete scope remains **XL**: causal/native-runtime diagnosis, a supported
+algorithm or measurement repair, exact semantics/history/access/persistence,
+meaningful negative controls, hosted unprofiled acceptance and integration.
+First distinguish deterministic composition work from unobserved runtime pauses.
+All four failed windows contain a paragraph boundary in fixed-workload arithmetic:
+states672/1440/1984/544 place Enter at zero-based offsets9/23/3/7. This is source
+arithmetic, not a captured action-cache identity or proof of cause.
+
+**Hypothesis:** the currently qualified leading-prefix optimization leaves
+substantial native work in a structural paragraph-containing cache, whereas plain
+typing caches are substantially cheaper. Reuse the existing actual manager
+fixture and eight lossless synthetic native captures, SHA256
+`714376723b3ef6a048796f7a1903a58181098960960cecb111e22e0594a2e7c8`.

+phase-specific primitive counts and diagnostic wall times, source/build/helper
+hashes and zero owned fixture timers/listeners after disposal. Wall times include
+instrumentation and controlled fixture endpoints; they are not browser latency
+or a reconstruction of any failed sample.
+
+One watchdog-protected process,60-second limit,2GiB combined RSS and normal memory
+pressure. Stop on the first hash/semantic/order/cleanup/resource failure and retain
+partial results. A setup repair must preserve its original failure. If no useful
+work distinction appears, stop this hypothesis as inconclusive; do not renew the
+same probe. If a distinction appears, record it and preregister any next semantic
+experiment or actual-runtime diagnostic before execution. No production change
+is admitted by a faster local timing alone.
+
+Operator gains an attributable finite investigation. Owner and Collaborator keep
+exact editing/history/persistence and unchanged responsiveness limits; editable
+Link guests retain every access fence. Production readiness does not justify
+dropping first failures, weakening100ms maxima or extrapolating CPU profiles from
+different samples. Existing dependency routing and all selected acceptance owners
+remain required for any eventual repair.
+
+### 📊 First offline result
+
+All32 declared flushes passed complete raw publication parity, input/property
+nonmutation and fixture cleanup on the first execution:1007ms including watchdog,
+416928KiB sampled peak, normal pressure. [Lossless probe/results/log manifest](evidence/SPN-146/offline-work/manifest.json)

+

+

+name: 🔬 Native Doc flush diagnosis
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [opened]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: native-doc-diagnostic-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  observation:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush'
+    name: One prior-native mobile observation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      VITE_SYNC_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_SELECTION_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_RESPONSIVENESS_EVIDENCE: '1'
+      VITE_DOC_FLUSH_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN146_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN108_BASELINE: '0'
+      SPINEL_E2E_PROJECT: doc-responsiveness
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean candidate dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+      - name: Install Chromium
+        run: |
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts

+      - name: Bind exact prior native implementation

+name: 🔬 Native Doc component counterfactual
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [synchronize]
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: spn146-native-component
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  component:
+    # One reachable pre-merge update only. Edits and later repair pushes cannot
+    # renew the registered allowance; GitHub reruns fail before installation.
+    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush' && github.event.before == '7e041c0c7c84bc28c56aeff1bda35b2a93654114'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    env:
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT: test-results/spn146-native-runtime
+    steps:
+      - name: Admit only the first workflow attempt
+        run: test "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean dependencies and pinned browser/converter
+        timeout-minutes: 8
+        run: |
+          export DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/spn146-trace-processor"
+          printf '%s\n' "DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH=$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          npm ci
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+          node scripts/ci/doc-trace-processor.ts "$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH"

+

+name: 🔬 Native Doc flush diagnosis
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [opened]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: native-doc-diagnostic-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  observation:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush'
+    name: One prior-native mobile observation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      VITE_SYNC_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_SELECTION_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_RESPONSIVENESS_EVIDENCE: '1'
+      VITE_DOC_FLUSH_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN146_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN108_BASELINE: '0'
+      SPINEL_E2E_PROJECT: doc-responsiveness
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean candidate dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+      - name: Install Chromium
+        run: |
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - name: Bind exact prior native implementation
+        run: node scripts/ci/prepare-doc-native-diagnostic.ts --prior-native
+      - name: Build diagnostic application
+        run: npm run build
+      - name: One diagnostic first attempt
+        run: npx playwright test --project=doc-responsiveness --grep 'mobile sustained native typing profile$' --retries=0
+      - name: Preserve complete or partial observation
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2

+          path: |
+            spn146-diagnostic-build.json
+            test-results/doc-responsiveness/
+            playwright-report/doc-responsiveness.json
+            !test-results/**/*.sqlite*
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

+name: 🔬 Native Doc component counterfactual
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [synchronize]
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: spn146-native-component
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  component:
+    # One reachable pre-merge update only. Edits and later repair pushes cannot
+    # renew the registered allowance; GitHub reruns fail before installation.
+    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush' && github.event.before == '7e041c0c7c84bc28c56aeff1bda35b2a93654114'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    env:
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT: test-results/spn146-native-runtime
+    steps:
+      - name: Admit only the first workflow attempt
+        run: test "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean dependencies and pinned browser/converter
+        timeout-minutes: 8
+        run: |
+          export DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/spn146-trace-processor"
+          printf '%s\n' "DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH=$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          npm ci
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+          node scripts/ci/doc-trace-processor.ts "$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH"
+          mkdir -p "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT"
+      - name: Prepare the fixed component bundle
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/preparation-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/build.ts
+      - name: One fixed 32-observation experiment
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/observation-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/run.ts
+      - name: Convert complete trace and assess every comparison

+        if: always()

 # ⚡ SPN-146 — mobile native flush budget
 
+## 🚀 Production run resume and first diagnostic
+
+**2026-11-04 America/Los_Angeles — owner requests continuing the backlog toward
+production.** Work starts on new branch `codex/spn-146-mobile-flush` from accepted
+main `2f442317dd2e1c188ae4a810ac094fd1162a4a2a`. No SPN-146 implementation branch
+or PR was found in the live remote inventory. The prior investigating chat is
+idle and records an execution-capability blocker, not a completed repair. No
+foreign branch is taken over. The owner's new rule requires a branch this agent
+did not create to be at least two hours old before takeover; verify that age and
+current ownership before any later takeover, preserving active/uncommitted work.
+
+SPN-141 now supplies two additional first-attempt failures on source
+`4e593fbaf9ea89585920053b9415f9a8eac0944f`, CI41970163093, job127056548327:
+plain1 capacity pair62/state1984 measures116.5ms (history56.9, collaboration59.6);
+plain3 pair17/state544 measures122.3ms (native121.5 plus0.8 outer remainder).
+Both clear32/32 queues to0/0; their overlapping long tasks are197/177ms. Neither
+failed interval has a CPU profile/trace. Full66-group history and content evidence
+remain separate from the failed maximum. The exact raw23-member artifact and
+independent reviews are preserved in immutable checkpoint
+[`b55833f5`](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/b55833f51111f772497d0c24ed81859dba4e8b22/docs/review-assets/spn-141-mobile-blocker-4e593fba).
+Its posted receipt and terminal redundant metadata cancellation are preserved in
+[`41962c6f`](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/41962c6f664995e59676d310db95110f9b9715c1/docs/review-assets/spn-141-blocked-receipt-4e593fba).
+SPN-141/140/120 and SPN-089 remain blocked; no old green or unchanged rerun is
+acceptance for these failures.
+
+### 🔬 Finite offline capability checkpoint
+
+Complete scope remains **XL**: causal/native-runtime diagnosis, a supported
+algorithm or measurement repair, exact semantics/history/access/persistence,
+meaningful negative controls, hosted unprofiled acceptance and integration.
+First distinguish deterministic composition work from unobserved runtime pauses.
+All four failed windows contain a paragraph boundary in fixed-workload arithmetic:
+states672/1440/1984/544 place Enter at zero-based offsets9/23/3/7. This is source
+arithmetic, not a captured action-cache identity or proof of cause.
+
+**Hypothesis:** the currently qualified leading-prefix optimization leaves
+substantial native work in a structural paragraph-containing cache, whereas plain
+typing caches are substantially cheaper. Reuse the existing actual manager
+fixture and eight lossless synthetic native captures, SHA256
+`714376723b3ef6a048796f7a1903a58181098960960cecb111e22e0594a2e7c8`.

+Transform the hash-verified OSS package in memory only; do not patch shared
+`node_modules`. Record full raw publication equality, own-data/input nonmutation,
+phase-specific primitive counts and diagnostic wall times, source/build/helper
+hashes and zero owned fixture timers/listeners after disposal. Wall times include
+instrumentation and controlled fixture endpoints; they are not browser latency
+or a reconstruction of any failed sample.
+
+One watchdog-protected process,60-second limit,2GiB combined RSS and normal memory
+pressure. Stop on the first hash/semantic/order/cleanup/resource failure and retain
+partial results. A setup repair must preserve its original failure. If no useful
+work distinction appears, stop this hypothesis as inconclusive; do not renew the
+same probe. If a distinction appears, record it and preregister any next semantic
+experiment or actual-runtime diagnostic before execution. No production change
+is admitted by a faster local timing alone.
+
+Operator gains an attributable finite investigation. Owner and Collaborator keep
+exact editing/history/persistence and unchanged responsiveness limits; editable
+Link guests retain every access fence. Production readiness does not justify
+dropping first failures, weakening100ms maxima or extrapolating CPU profiles from
+different samples. Existing dependency routing and all selected acceptance owners
+remain required for any eventual repair.
+
+### 📊 First offline result
+
+All32 declared flushes passed complete raw publication parity, input/property
+nonmutation and fixture cleanup on the first execution:1007ms including watchdog,
+416928KiB sampled peak, normal pressure. [Lossless probe/results/log manifest](evidence/SPN-146/offline-work/manifest.json)

+name: 🔬 Native Doc flush diagnosis
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [opened]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: native-doc-diagnostic-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  observation:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush'
+    name: One prior-native mobile observation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      VITE_SYNC_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_SELECTION_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_RESPONSIVENESS_EVIDENCE: '1'
+      VITE_DOC_FLUSH_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN146_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN108_BASELINE: '0'
+      SPINEL_E2E_PROJECT: doc-responsiveness
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean candidate dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+      - name: Install Chromium
+        run: |
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - name: Bind exact prior native implementation
+        run: node scripts/ci/prepare-doc-native-diagnostic.ts --prior-native
+      - name: Build diagnostic application
+        run: npm run build
+      - name: One diagnostic first attempt
+        run: npx playwright test --project=doc-responsiveness --grep 'mobile sustained native typing profile$' --retries=0
+      - name: Preserve complete or partial observation
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
+        with:
+          name: spn146-prior-native-diagnostic
+          path: |
+            spn146-diagnostic-build.json
+            test-results/doc-responsiveness/
+            playwright-report/doc-responsiveness.json
+            !test-results/**/*.sqlite*
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

+name: 🔬 Native Doc component counterfactual
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [synchronize]
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: spn146-native-component
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  component:
+    # One reachable pre-merge update only. Edits and later repair pushes cannot
+    # renew the registered allowance; GitHub reruns fail before installation.
+    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush' && github.event.before == '7e041c0c7c84bc28c56aeff1bda35b2a93654114'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    env:
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT: test-results/spn146-native-runtime
+    steps:
+      - name: Admit only the first workflow attempt
+        run: test "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean dependencies and pinned browser/converter
+        timeout-minutes: 8
+        run: |
+          export DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/spn146-trace-processor"
+          printf '%s\n' "DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH=$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          npm ci
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+          node scripts/ci/doc-trace-processor.ts "$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH"
+          mkdir -p "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT"
+      - name: Prepare the fixed component bundle
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/preparation-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/build.ts
+      - name: One fixed 32-observation experiment
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/observation-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/run.ts
+      - name: Convert complete trace and assess every comparison

+        if: always()

+          path: test-results/spn146-native-runtime/

+          retention-days: 30

 # ⚡ SPN-146 — mobile native flush budget
 
+## 🚀 Production run resume and first diagnostic
+
+**2026-11-04 America/Los_Angeles — owner requests continuing the backlog toward
+production.** Work starts on new branch `codex/spn-146-mobile-flush` from accepted
+main `2f442317dd2e1c188ae4a810ac094fd1162a4a2a`. No SPN-146 implementation branch
+or PR was found in the live remote inventory. The prior investigating chat is
+idle and records an execution-capability blocker, not a completed repair. No
+foreign branch is taken over. The owner's new rule requires a branch this agent
+did not create to be at least two hours old before takeover; verify that age and
+current ownership before any later takeover, preserving active/uncommitted work.
+
+SPN-141 now supplies two additional first-attempt failures on source
+`4e593fbaf9ea89585920053b9415f9a8eac0944f`, CI41970163093, job127056548327:
+plain1 capacity pair62/state1984 measures116.5ms (history56.9, collaboration59.6);
+plain3 pair17/state544 measures122.3ms (native121.5 plus0.8 outer remainder).
+Both clear32/32 queues to0/0; their overlapping long tasks are197/177ms. Neither
+failed interval has a CPU profile/trace. Full66-group history and content evidence
+remain separate from the failed maximum. The exact raw23-member artifact and
+independent reviews are preserved in immutable checkpoint
+[`b55833f5`](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/b55833f51111f772497d0c24ed81859dba4e8b22/docs/review-assets/spn-141-mobile-blocker-4e593fba).
+Its posted receipt and terminal redundant metadata cancellation are preserved in
+[`41962c6f`](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/41962c6f664995e59676d310db95110f9b9715c1/docs/review-assets/spn-141-blocked-receipt-4e593fba).
+SPN-141/140/120 and SPN-089 remain blocked; no old green or unchanged rerun is
+acceptance for these failures.
+
+### 🔬 Finite offline capability checkpoint
+
+Complete scope remains **XL**: causal/native-runtime diagnosis, a supported
+algorithm or measurement repair, exact semantics/history/access/persistence,
+meaningful negative controls, hosted unprofiled acceptance and integration.
+First distinguish deterministic composition work from unobserved runtime pauses.
+All four failed windows contain a paragraph boundary in fixed-workload arithmetic:
+states672/1440/1984/544 place Enter at zero-based offsets9/23/3/7. This is source
+arithmetic, not a captured action-cache identity or proof of cause.
+
+**Hypothesis:** the currently qualified leading-prefix optimization leaves
+substantial native work in a structural paragraph-containing cache, whereas plain
+typing caches are substantially cheaper. Reuse the existing actual manager
+fixture and eight lossless synthetic native captures, SHA256
+`714376723b3ef6a048796f7a1903a58181098960960cecb111e22e0594a2e7c8`.

+phase-specific primitive counts and diagnostic wall times, source/build/helper
+hashes and zero owned fixture timers/listeners after disposal. Wall times include
+instrumentation and controlled fixture endpoints; they are not browser latency
+or a reconstruction of any failed sample.
+

+pressure. Stop on the first hash/semantic/order/cleanup/resource failure and retain
+partial results. A setup repair must preserve its original failure. If no useful
+work distinction appears, stop this hypothesis as inconclusive; do not renew the
+same probe. If a distinction appears, record it and preregister any next semantic
+experiment or actual-runtime diagnostic before execution. No production change
+is admitted by a faster local timing alone.
+
+Operator gains an attributable finite investigation. Owner and Collaborator keep
+exact editing/history/persistence and unchanged responsiveness limits; editable
+Link guests retain every access fence. Production readiness does not justify
+dropping first failures, weakening100ms maxima or extrapolating CPU profiles from
+different samples. Existing dependency routing and all selected acceptance owners

+
+### 📊 First offline result
+
+All32 declared flushes passed complete raw publication parity, input/property

+name: 🔬 Native Doc flush diagnosis
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [opened]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: native-doc-diagnostic-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  observation:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush'
+    name: One prior-native mobile observation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      VITE_SYNC_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_SELECTION_EVIDENCE: '0'
+      VITE_DOC_RESPONSIVENESS_EVIDENCE: '1'
+      VITE_DOC_FLUSH_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN146_DIAGNOSTIC: '1'
+      SPN108_BASELINE: '0'
+      SPINEL_E2E_PROJECT: doc-responsiveness
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean candidate dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+      - name: Install Chromium
+        run: |
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - name: Bind exact prior native implementation
+        run: node scripts/ci/prepare-doc-native-diagnostic.ts --prior-native
+      - name: Build diagnostic application
+        run: npm run build
+      - name: One diagnostic first attempt
+        run: npx playwright test --project=doc-responsiveness --grep 'mobile sustained native typing profile$' --retries=0
+      - name: Preserve complete or partial observation
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
+        with:
+          name: spn146-prior-native-diagnostic
+          path: |
+            spn146-diagnostic-build.json
+            test-results/doc-responsiveness/
+            playwright-report/doc-responsiveness.json
+            !test-results/**/*.sqlite*
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

+name: 🔬 Native Doc component counterfactual
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [synchronize]
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: spn146-native-component
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  component:
+    # One reachable pre-merge update only. Edits and later repair pushes cannot
+    # renew the registered allowance; GitHub reruns fail before installation.
+    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'codex/spn-146-mobile-flush' && github.event.before == '7e041c0c7c84bc28c56aeff1bda35b2a93654114'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    env:
+      SPN146_REVIEWED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT: test-results/spn146-native-runtime
+    steps:
+      - name: Admit only the first workflow attempt
+        run: test "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          package-manager-cache: false
+      - name: Clean dependencies and pinned browser/converter
+        timeout-minutes: 8
+        run: |
+          export DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/spn146-trace-processor"
+          printf '%s\n' "DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH=$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          npm ci
+          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+          node scripts/ci/doc-trace-processor.ts "$DOC_TRACE_PROCESSOR_PATH"
+          mkdir -p "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT"
+      - name: Prepare the fixed component bundle
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/preparation-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/build.ts
+      - name: One fixed 32-observation experiment
+        run: node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/watchdog.ts "$SPN146_RUNTIME_OUTPUT/observation-watchdog.json" node scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/run.ts
+      - name: Convert complete trace and assess every comparison

+        if: always()

 # ⚡ SPN-146 — mobile native flush budget
 
+## 🚀 Production run resume and first diagnostic
+
+**2026-11-04 America/Los_Angeles — owner requests continuing the backlog toward
+production.** Work starts on new branch `codex/spn-146-mobile-flush` from accepted
+main `2f442317dd2e1c188ae4a810ac094fd1162a4a2a`. No SPN-146 implementation branch
+or PR was found in the live remote inventory. The prior investigating chat is
+idle and records an execution-capability blocker, not a completed repair. No
+foreign branch is taken over. The owner's new rule requires a branch this agent
+did not create to be at least two hours old before takeover; verify that age and
+current ownership before any later takeover, preserving active/uncommitted work.
+
+SPN-141 now supplies two additional first-attempt failures on source
+`4e593fbaf9ea89585920053b9415f9a8eac0944f`, CI41970163093, job127056548327:
+plain1 capacity pair62/state1984 measures116.5ms (history56.9, collaboration59.6);
+plain3 pair17/state544 measures122.3ms (native121.5 plus0.8 outer remainder).
+Both clear32/32 queues to0/0; their overlapping long tasks are197/177ms. Neither
+failed interval has a CPU profile/trace. Full66-group history and content evidence
+remain separate from the failed maximum. The exact raw23-member artifact and
+independent reviews are preserved in immutable checkpoint
+[`b55833f5`](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/b55833f51111f772497d0c24ed81859dba4e8b22/docs/review-assets/spn-141-mobile-blocker-4e593fba).
+Its posted receipt and terminal redundant metadata cancellation are preserved in
+[`41962c6f`](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/41962c6f664995e59676d310db95110f9b9715c1/docs/review-assets/spn-141-blocked-receipt-4e593fba).
+SPN-141/140/120 and SPN-089 remain blocked; no old green or unchanged rerun is
+acceptance for these failures.
+
+### 🔬 Finite offline capability checkpoint
+
+Complete scope remains **XL**: causal/native-runtime diagnosis, a supported
+algorithm or measurement repair, exact semantics/history/access/persistence,
+meaningful negative controls, hosted unprofiled acceptance and integration.
+First distinguish deterministic composition work from unobserved runtime pauses.
+All four failed windows contain a paragraph boundary in fixed-workload arithmetic:
+states672/1440/1984/544 place Enter at zero-based offsets9/23/3/7. This is source
+arithmetic, not a captured action-cache identity or proof of cause.
+
+**Hypothesis:** the currently qualified leading-prefix optimization leaves
+substantial native work in a structural paragraph-containing cache, whereas plain
+typing caches are substantially cheaper. Reuse the existing actual manager
+fixture and eight lossless synthetic native captures, SHA256
+`714376723b3ef6a048796f7a1903a58181098960960cecb111e22e0594a2e7c8`.

+current main patch. No browser, server, workflow, forced GC or acceptance retry.
+Transform the hash-verified OSS package in memory only; do not patch shared
+`node_modules`. Record full raw publication equality, own-data/input nonmutation,
+phase-specific primitive counts and diagnostic wall times, source/build/helper
+hashes and zero owned fixture timers/listeners after disposal. Wall times include
+instrumentation and controlled fixture endpoints; they are not browser latency
+or a reconstruction of any failed sample.
+
+One watchdog-protected process,60-second limit,2GiB combined RSS and normal memory
+pressure. Stop on the first hash/semantic/order/cleanup/resource failure and retain
+partial results. A setup repair must preserve its original failure. If no useful
+work distinction appears, stop this hypothesis as inconclusive; do not renew the
+same probe. If a distinction appears, record it and preregister any next semantic
+experiment or actual-runtime diagnostic before execution. No production change
+is admitted by a faster local timing alone.
+
+Operator gains an attributable finite investigation. Owner and Collaborator keep
+exact editing/history/persistence and unchanged responsiveness limits; editable
+Link guests retain every access fence. Production readiness does not justify
+dropping first failures, weakening100ms maxima or extrapolating CPU profiles from
+different samples. Existing dependency routing and all selected acceptance owners
+remain required for any eventual repair.
+
+### 📊 First offline result
+
+All32 declared flushes passed complete raw publication parity, input/property
+nonmutation and fixture cleanup on the first execution:1007ms including watchdog,
+416928KiB sampled peak, normal pressure. [Lossless probe/results/log manifest](evidence/SPN-146/offline-work/manifest.json)

+

+another resource abort defers local application execution rather than looping.

+production admission. They identify the missing distinction between structural
+boundary composition and later copies of its accumulated body. Before choosing
+an algorithm, execute one narrower **four-flush segment diagnostic**: captured
+plain cache0 and paragraph cache4, current ES/CJS builds only. Reuse the actual
+manager fixture; wrap each native JSONX composition to retain phase, redo/undo
+source-index identity, lossless input/output shapes and primitive deltas. Keep
